scenario_description:
Objective: Resume Leo's interrupted eSIM download on an approved existing connection before the issued QR expires.
Emerging Need: The download begins, then a neighborhood broadband outage removes the household's only active connection while the child line is not yet usable.
Decision Context: Retrieve the standing permission to use Mina's existing family hotspot. Coordinate a nearby connection and prompt owner completion of the same QR download; no carrier-account correction or new fee is involved.
Consequence: After Mina leaves and the QR expires, that activation window is lost, though later contact and trip planning can remain useful.

parameter.title: Leo seventh-grade field trip departure
parameter.description: Bus leaves before homeroom; students should bring a charged phone for pickup updates.

parameter.reference: BBM eSIM QR replacement for Leo line
parameter.description: One-time eSIM replacement QR fee charged during child-line activation.

parameter.subject: eSIM activation started: session ACT-91572
parameter.body: BlueBridge session ACT-91572 began the eSIM download at 09:12. This already-paid QR remains reusable on the same approved handset until 15:00 today if a network interruption occurs. No new QR or carrier-account review is needed for an interrupted download.

parameter.content: The download stopped when our home broadband went out. The new line is not active, so this phone has no mobile data yet. The neighborhood repair notice says service may not return until tomorrow. The QR still shows a resume button; the account and device match.

I will be at the house from 12:30 until 14:30 with my charged phone, then away until tomorrow afternoon. My existing hotspot data is included; if Leo needs that trusted connection I can stay beside him while he resumes his download. No password needs to be texted.

parameter.subject: ACT-91572 download window expired
parameter.body: The issued QR for ACT-91572 expired at 15:00 with the download unfinished. The child line is still inactive; the next ordinary QR issue opens after tomorrow's 07:15 field-trip departure. No new purchase has been made.
